test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ram invested 45% of his salary in a scheme for 3 years which offers 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually. If he receives Rs. 5,958 as total interest, then find Ram's salary?
solution:
Given:

Principal = P

Rate = 10%

Amount = Rs. 5,958

Time = 3 years

Formula used:

A = P(1 + r/100)t

where, A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest , t = time

Calculation:

A = P(1 + r/100)t

⇒ P + 5958 = P(1 + (10)/(100))3

⇒ P + 5958 = P((11)/(10))3

⇒ P + 5958 = P((1331)/(1000))

⇒ 5958 = (331)/(1000)P

⇒ P = 5958 × (1000)/(331)

⇒ P = 18000

Now, according to question,

45% of Salary = 18000

⇒ Salary = 18000/0.45 = 40,000

∴ The required value of Salary is Rs. 40,000.
